headline: SOUTHERN CROSS GOLD CUTS 178.6 G/T AuEq OVER 2.7M AT SUNDAY CREEK — DEEPEST INFILL HIT YET ON GD40 VEIN AT 662M
source_name: Discovery Alert / Southern Cross Gold (ASX: SX2)
snippet: Southern Cross Gold (ASX: SX2) reported infill drilling at the Golden Dyke Prospect at Sunday Creek in Victoria returned 2.7m at 178.6 g/t AuEq from 662.3m depth — the 13th-best composite intersection at the project and the deepest on the GD40 vein set. Tightening hole spacing from ~50m to ~30m is lifting grades, with eight composites and twelve individual assays above 100 g/t Au across four of five new holes; a separate hole hit 2.2m at 49.0 g/t AuEq containing 53.5% antimony.

headline: QMINES FLOATS A RIG ON A FLOODED PIT — MAIDEN PONTOON DRILLING BEATS RESOURCE MODEL: 2.07% COPPER OVER 6.7M AT MT CHALMERS
snippet: QMines (ASX: QML) reported first assays from its purpose-built floating diamond drill rig on the pit lake at Mt Chalmers, Queensland, returning 16.7m at 1.04% Cu, 1.16 g/t Au and 26 g/t Ag including 6.7m at 2.07% Cu, 2.37 g/t Au and 60 g/t Ag — grades ~20% above the existing block model. A second hole 32m along strike repeated copper-gold-silver-zinc mineralisation; 37 additional holes across three rigs are still pending assay.

headline: DISCOVERY MINING'S DOME VEIN GRADES 278 G/T GOLD — PORCUPINE CAMP GIANT GROWING, DUAL RESOURCE ESTIMATES DUE Q4 2026
snippet: Discovery Mining (TSX: DSV) reported results across its Dome, TVZ and Owl Creek projects in Ontario's Porcupine Camp, including a 1.1m quartz vein at 278.48 g/t gold and a 17.3m composite averaging 9.09 g/t at Dome; TVZ confirmed 30.5m at 5.65 g/t on the 1680 level. Shares rose 15% on the news; resource estimates for Dome and TVZ are targeted for late 2026, with a 1.5km underground drift now extending from Hoyle Pond toward Owl Creek.

headline: MANHATTAN GOLD'S MAIDEN SPECTRE HOLES DELIVER 3.18% COPPER AND 147.9 G/T SILVER OVER 6M IN NUNAVUT VMS HIT
snippet: Manhattan Gold (ASX: MHC) confirmed a new VMS discovery at Spectre, 26km from its Jaws gold target in Nunavut, with the first hole returning 6.10m at 3.18% Cu, 1.37 g/t Au, 147.9 g/t Ag and 1.35% Zn from 45.72m depth — plus an upper zinc zone of 19.82m at 5.55% Zn including 3.05m at 29.50% Zn. A second hole 77m along strike repeated the polymetallic mineralisation; three holes now define a 340m strike length at Spectre.

headline: ALLIGATOR ENERGY PUSHES BLACKBUSH URANIUM 1KM SOUTH ON NEW GROUND: 5.2M AT 1,498 PPM AND 6.6M AT 1,245 PPM eU3O8
snippet: Alligator Energy (ASX: AGE) reported uranium mineralisation approximately 1km south of the previously southernmost known Blackbush drill hole at Samphire, South Australia, with two adjacent holes returning 5.2m at 1,498ppm and 6.6m at 1,245ppm eU3O8 above the 250ppm cut-off. The ~300-hole Growth Strategy is one-third complete with 91 holes drilled; a Samphire Mineral Resource update is targeted for Q1/Q2 2027 as infill drilling tightens spacing from 200m×400m to 100m×100m to convert Inferred to Indicated.

headline: COPPER HOLDS ABOVE $14,400 AS CENTINELA STRIKE CLOCK TICKS TO OCT. 13 — JPMORGAN: AI DATA CENTRES ADD 110,000T/YR NEW DEMAND
snippet: LME copper is holding above $14,400/t with Antofagasta's Centinela facing an October 13 strike deadline and Escondida mediation unresolved after a worker fatality paused talks — while JPMorgan estimates AI-specific data centres are adding ~110,000 tonnes of incremental annual copper demand in 2026, with a single 100MW hyperscale facility consuming ~4,700 tonnes alone. Citigroup maintains a $15,000/t year-end target; Chile's copper output fell to a 15-year low in September.

headline: SUNSHINE METALS HITS 4M AT 11.11 G/T GOLD AT SYBIL — SECOND NEW TARGET NEAR MT MOSS PLANT IN 66-HOLE RC PROGRAM
snippet: Sunshine Metals (ASX: SHN) reported 4.0m at 11.11 g/t Au from 62m including 2m at 20.22 g/t at its Sybil target near the Mt Moss processing plant in north Queensland, within a 66-hole, 4,357m RC program now generating multiple new gold targets. Sybil is the second new gold discovery identified in the current program and sits proximal to existing infrastructure, keeping near-mine development optionality open.

headline: TOP 50 MINERS SHED $264 BILLION IN SEPTEMBER — GOLD RALLY FADES AS FED RATE HIKE BITES, SHANDONG GOLD DROPS 27.8%
snippet: The world's 50 most valuable mining companies lost $264 billion in market capitalisation in September — the second-largest monthly drop on record — as the Fed's first rate hike since 2023 and surging bond yields dragged gold futures down 6.4%, erasing three-quarters of August's record $357 billion gain. Gold miners led losses, with Shandong Gold down 27.8% after cutting its 2026 mined gold target from 49t to 36-38t on safety incident investigations, and Kinross losing 21.3% after slashing 2026-27 output guidance 8% on weather and operational challenges.

headline: EXPERTS: DEEP-SEA MINING ECONOMICS DON'T STACK UP — FLAGSHIP NODULE PROJECT DECLARED FINANCIALLY UNVIABLE
snippet: Undersea scientists and economists are publicly questioning whether deep-sea mining's critical mineral promise justifies its costs, with a flagship polymetallic nodule project declared financially unviable in a new techno-economic assessment despite Trump's seabed mining executive order and the ISA finalising its commercial framework. Experts warn projected returns are highly sensitive to unvalidated cost estimates and metal price volatility — and that early investors and machinery vendors may be the only guaranteed beneficiaries.

headline: SURGE BATTERY METALS PEGS NEVADA NORTH AT US$9.81B NPV — LARGEST U.S. LITHIUM DLE PROJECT ADVANCES TO FULL FEASIBILITY
source_name: The Deep Dive / Surge Battery Metals (TSX: SURG)
snippet: Surge Battery Metals (TSX: SURG) published a pre-feasibility study for its Nevada North Lithium Project showing an after-tax NPV of US$9.81 billion at 8% discount, a 23.6% IRR and 218.3Mt proven and probable reserves at US$4,719/t LCE operating cost — among the strongest economics of any lithium direct lithium extraction project globally. The JV (67.5% Surge / 32.5% Evolution Mining) is advancing directly into FEL 3 engineering and a feasibility study; battery-grade production targeted in Nevada from 2029.
